dz: 德川家康被后阳正天皇授予将军称号，并在日本江户建立德川幕府。
de: Tokugawa Ieyasu is granted the title of shōgun from Emperor Go-Yōzei, and establishes the Tokugawa shogunate in Edo, Japan.

t: Turco-Mongol皇帝Timur在大马士革撒了尿.
te: Turco-Mongol emperor Timur sacks Damascus.
dz: Turco-Mongol皇帝Timur在大马士革撒了尿.
de: Turco-Mongol emperor Timur sacks Damascus.

t: 英国在马加特近海的马加特战役中战胜了一支法国-卡斯蒂利亚-弗莱米什分舰队.
te: English victory over a Franco-Castilian-Flemish fleet in the Battle of Margate off the coast of Margate.
dz: 英国在马加特近海的马加特战役中战胜了一支法国-卡斯蒂利亚-弗莱米什分舰队.
de: English victory over a Franco-Castilian-Flemish fleet in the Battle of Margate off the coast of Margate.

t: 英国国王理查一世在法国作战时被弩箭射伤，于 4 月 6 日死亡。
te: King Richard I of England is wounded by a crossbow bolt while fighting in France, leading to his death on April 6.
dz: 英国国王理查一世在法国作战时被弩箭射伤，于 4 月 6 日死亡。
de: King Richard I of England is wounded by a crossbow bolt while fighting in France, leading to his death on April 6.
